message.content: {"caption":"A left-to-right timeline shows a strategy developing from link navigation into verification, adaptive checking, and task-aware reassessment.","description":"A horizontal diagram presents stages of strategy development along a winding gray trail with small gray dots and blue and yellow circular nodes. At the bottom, a line labeled “Test-time Learning Timeline” ends in a right-pointing arrow, indicating progression from left to right. The first stage, “Procedural/execution strategy,” is paired with a hand-clicking icon and the instruction to actively look for and click “Next Page,” “Page X,” or “Load More” links. Next, “Atomic self-reflection” is illustrated with a magnifying-glass icon; its example says it is crucial to first re-check an element’s current identifier. The “Evolved adaptive check” stage has a target-like icon and advises leveraging available search or filter functions before scanning to ensure completeness before reporting. At the right, “Generalized complex/effective strategy” is paired with a compass-like icon. Its text recommends regularly cross-referencing the current view with task requirements to prevent errors, and reassessing options such as search filters or alternative sections when the data does not align with expectations. The stages are arranged in a left-to-right progression; there are no separate labeled arrows between them.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
